svg.title: Tiles in multiples of 3
svg.desc: Top-down view of the ocean layout: each ring is eight copies of the same 129 × 129 vertex tile around an empty middle; the next ring in is three times smaller and fills that middle, so detail is densest at the centre.
svg.text: Every tile is the same 129 × 129 vertex
Ring = 8 tiles around a hole one tile wide.
The next ring in is 3× smaller, and its
outer edge is exactly that hole.
Vertex spacing grows 3× per ring outward,
so far water gets fewer vertices.
Grid lines inside tiles are schematic (the real tiles have 128 quads per side). Rings drawn: 4; the editor view below shows more.
